questions.question: ___________ is one of the billions of galaxies of known universe.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (C): Andromeda. Andromeda is a galaxy outside our own milky way.It is one of the billions of galaxies in the known universe.

questions.question: The word science is derived from _______word scientia.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (B): Latin. The word “science” comes from the Latin word scientia. It means knowledge or understanding.

questions.question: Physical science deals with the study of ________.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (B): non- living. Physical sciences deal with non-living matter and energy (such as physics, chemistry, astronomy, and geology), whereas biological sciences study living organisms.

questions.question: A car is made on the principle of ________.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (A): mechanics. A car works on the laws of motion and forces. These principles belong to the branch of mechanics.

questions.question: _________ is the study of matter, energy and their interaction.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (D): physics. Physics studies matter, energy and how they interact.It explains natural physical phenomenon.

questions.question: Much of the universe is made up of ________.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (A): Plasma. Most stars and galaxies are made of plasma. That is why plasma forms most of the universe.

questions.question: ______ is a base quantity.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (A): mass. Mass is a base quantity. It is not derived from other quantities.

questions.question: Least count of vernier caliper is _________.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (C): 0.01 cm. Least count is the smallest value a vernier caliper can measure. For a standard vernier caliper, it is 0.01 cm.

questions.question: Which one of the following is not a derived unit?
questions.explanation: Correct Option (A): Electric current. Electric current is a base quantity. Force, pressure and density are derived quantities.

questions.question: The volume of one liter cube is _______.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (B): 1000 cm3. One liter is equal to 1000cubic centimeters. This is the standard volume conversion.

questions.question: The term used internationally for multiples and submultiples is called _______.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (B): Prefixes. Prefixes like kilo, milli and micro show multiples or submultiples. They help express very large or very small values.

questions.question: One tera is equal to ______.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (C): 1012. The prefix tera (T) represents 10¹² (one trillion), while 10⁻¹² is pico (p).

questions.question: _________is the standard form of 170500 m.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (A): 1.7 × 10^5 m. In scientific notation (standard form), there must be exactly one non-zero digit before the decimal point: 170500 m = 1.705 × 10⁵ m ≈ 1.7 × 10⁵ m.

questions.question: ________is the total length of vernier scale.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (D): 9 mm. In standard FBISE Class 9 physics, the Vernier scale has 10 divisions spanning a total length of 9 mm (each division is 0.9 mm).

questions.question: ________telescope orbits around the earth and provide information about stars.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (C): Hubble Space. The Hubble Space Telescope orbits Earth. It provides detailed Information about stars and galaxies.

questions.question: Zero error is _______of zero correction.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (A): negative. Zero error is negative if the instrument reads more than the actual value; zero correction is applied in the opposite direction.

questions.question: One mili litre is equal to ______.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (A): 1 cm3. 1 ml equals 1 cubic

questions.question: If zero line of Vernier scale is on the left side of the zero of the main scale then zero error is __________.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (B): negative. If the zero line of the Vernier scale lies to the left of the main scale zero, the zero error is negative (and zero correction is positive).

questions.question: If zero line of Vernier scale is on the right side of the zero of the main scale then zero error is _________.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (A): positive. Right shift causes positive zero error.

questions.question: Least count of micro meter screw gauge is ________.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (D): 0.01 mm. Micrometer reads 0.01 mm accurately

questions.question: _________ is the distance between consective thread on the spindle of screw gauge.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (D): 1 mm. Pitch is 1 mm in most screw guages. 32.Total number of divisions on circular scale of screw gauge is ____. (a) 50 ✓ (b) 100 (c) 10 (d) 20 EXPLANATION: Circular scale often has 50 divisions. 33.If zero of circular scale coincides with index line, then zero error will be ___. questions.question: If zero of circular scale has crossed the index line, then zero error will be ___.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (B): negative. When the zero of the circular scale has crossed the index line, the zero error of the micrometer screw gauge is negative.

questions.question: ____ is the least count of mechanical stopwatch.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (C): 0.1s. The least count of a mechanical stopwatch is 0.1 s, while that of a digital stopwatch is 0.01 s.

questions.question: 2.0098 has ___significant figures.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (D): 5. All non-zero digits and zeros between non-zero digits are significant. Thus, 2.0098 has 5 significant figures.

questions.question: 0.00078 has ____significant figures.
questions.explanation: Correct Option (D): 2. Leading zeros are not significant; they only indicate decimal place. Only digits 7 and 8 are significant.
